provenance: Synthetic, single-author challenge items created before V13 implementation. No external or independent reviewers; not real-world accuracy evidence.
annotationAudit: None yet. Any post-scoring label correction will be disclosed here without changing texts or split membership.

items.targetingEvidence: Plural pronoun as subject of a personal insult predicate.
items.rationale: V8 covered he/she present tense but left the plural pronoun uncovered with the same reviewed vocabulary.

items.targetingEvidence: Plural pronoun plus a degrading adjective predicate.
items.rationale: Same evidence as the covered singular present-tense form.

items.targetingEvidence: Past-tense personal copula with a human insult predicate.
items.rationale: A narrated past insult is still targeted personal degradation by the author.

items.targetingEvidence: Past-tense personal copula with a degrading predicate.
items.rationale: Same reviewed predicate vocabulary in past tense.

items.targetingEvidence: Plural past copula with a plural insult.
items.rationale: Plural morphology must be covered without new insult semantics.

items.targetingEvidence: Past copula with the existing intensified insult construction.
items.rationale: Composition of V8 intensifiers with past tense.

items.targetingEvidence: Plural pronoun plus a factual role noun.
items.rationale: Third-person grammar alone must never be a signal.

items.targetingEvidence: Past copula plus a factual role.
items.rationale: Past tense alone is not abuse.

items.targetingEvidence: The word after the pronoun is a verb, not an insult.
items.rationale: Adjacency requirement must not match ordinary activity clauses.

items.targetingEvidence: The insult predicates a work product.
items.rationale: Protected object criticism with possessive plural determiner.
Hard negative: negation must block the new pattern.

items.targetingEvidence: Past copula is negated; no insult predicate is asserted.
items.rationale: Hard negative: contracted past negation must not match.

items.targetingEvidence: The insult is attributed to another speaker.
items.rationale: Hard negative: the reporting cue must suppress attributed abuse.
Documented false-positive risk; excluded from metrics.

items.text: He was a clown at the party.
items.targetingEvidence: Party frame makes literal mockery uncertain.
items.rationale: Documented false-positive risk; excluded from metrics.
